settings.text: A silk twilly scarf for tying to handles. Hand-rolled edges. Made in a Como mill.

settings.title: Details
settings.content: A finishing touch that changes everything. The Velantra Bag Scarf wraps your favorite tote handle in soft, lightweight silk-blend — or doubles as a hair tie or neck scarf when the mood strikes. The small detail that signals you thought about everything.

settings.title: Materials & Care
settings.content:
Material
Soft, lightweight silk-blend fabric.

Care
Spot clean or dry clean only. Store flat or loosely rolled to preserve the drape, and keep out of prolonged direct sunlight to protect the color.

settings.title: Shipping & Returns
settings.content:
Free shipping on all orders over $75. Once your order is placed, it ships and arrives within 7 to 10 business days.

We accept returns within 30 days of delivery for items in original, unused condition with all tags attached. Exchanges are always free. If something isn’t right, reach out — we’ll make it right.

settings.title: Two Year Warranty
settings.content:
Every Velantra piece is covered for two years against defects in materials and construction. If anything goes wrong in normal use, we’ll repair or replace it.

After two years, we continue to offer repair service for the cost of materials. Designed to last decades, not seasons.

settings.headline: Three Ways to Tie
settings.body: Handle wrap. Neck knot. Belt loop. A 90cm silk twilly with hand-rolled edges.

settings.headline: Como-Milled Silk
settings.body: Woven and printed at the same Como mill that supplies the houses. Hand-rolled at the edge — never machine-hemmed.

settings.headline: Limited Runs
settings.body: Each colorway runs once, then retires. Never re-stocked.
